control.description: CLI-only loopback control; stdin is the op args object. Same guide/query/act catalog and errors; default purpose=self-test, notify=null for dispatch. Never exposed via management MCP.

wait.description: CLI-only bounded read: JSON Pointers address the unwrapped result; == and != require JSON literals; exists matches present null too. Missing pointers never match !=. Conditions are AND. Native wait ops use their event waits; other reads poll every 500ms.

install-shim.description: macOS only. Symlink ~/.local/bin/arc to this App bin/arc. Refuse other existing files. Uninstall removes only a recorded unchanged symlink for this instance.
